library(tidyverse)

# PARTE 1

##### EXERCÍCIO 1:

```{r}
elephants = read.csv("ElephantsMF.csv")
```

##### EXERCÍCIO 2:

```{r}
head(elephants)
```

##### EXERCÍCIO 3:

```{r}

ggplot(elephants) +
  geom_point(aes(Age, Height))

```

##### EXERCÍCIO 4:

```{r}

MM = mean(elephants$Height[elephants$Sex == "M"])

MF = mean(elephants$Height[elephants$Sex == "F"])


MM
MF
```

##### EXERCÍCIO 5:

```{r}

ggplot(elephants, aes(Sex,Height))+
  geom_boxplot(aes(reorder(Sex, Height, FUN = median)))
```

##### EXERCÍCIO 6:

```{r}

Ex6Ele = filter(elephants, Age > 14)

NMM = mean(Ex6Ele$Height[Ex6Ele$Sex == "M"])

NMF = mean(Ex6Ele$Height[Ex6Ele$Sex == "F"])


NMM
NMF

```

# Parte 2:

##### EXERCÍCIO 7:

```{r}
diabetes = read.csv("diabetes_012_health_indicators_BRFSS2015.csv")
```

##### EXERCÍCIO 8:

```{r}
str(diabetes)
```

##### EXERCÍCIO 9:

```{r}

diabetes$Sex = as.factor(diabetes$Sex)
levels(diabetes$Sex) = c("F","M")

```

##### EXERCÍCIO 10:

```{r}

ggplot( diabetes, aes(Diabetes_012) ) + 
  geom_bar( aes(fill = Sex)) 

```

##### EXERCÍCIO 11:

```{r}
ggplot( diabetes, aes(Diabetes_012) ) + 
  geom_bar( aes(fill = Sex), 
            position = "fill") 
```

##### EXERCÍCIO 12:

```{r}
ggplot(diabetes,aes(x = BMI))+
  geom_histogram(aes( fill = Sex))+
  facet_wrap(~Sex)


```

##### EXERCÍCIO 13:

```{r}
ggplot(diabetes,aes(x = BMI))+
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density),fill = Sex),binwidth = 5)+
  geom_density(color = "black")+
  facet_wrap(~Sex)

```
